assessments.reasoning: I independently retrieved and verified the exact bytes of The Organization of the Object Code Generator in Algol 68 H and inspected the cited passage (Abstract, physical PDF p. 3). Boom’s 1975 IW 33/75 abstract on physical page 3 names Algol 68 H as a compiler project for Algol 68 and presents the design’s progression from TREE to relocatable object output.

challenge.method: Compare the planned full compiler with the 1978 stated class of supported programs and with the roles of Algol W and Janus.
challenge.results: IW 33/75 is prospective about complete coverage. IW 103/78 describes a formats-free input class. Algol W and Janus are respectively an implementation language and an intermediate language.

limitations: The 1975 abstract establishes the project and design objective. Its coverage target is distinct from completed operation.
